# Northstar Records Portal Operations Handbook

## File uploads

The portal accepts CSV and JSON files. A single uploaded file may be no larger
than 25 MB. ZIP archives and spreadsheet files are not accepted.

## Data retention

Files from successful imports are retained for 45 calendar days and then
permanently deleted. Files from failed imports are retained for 7 calendar days
to support troubleshooting.

## Support coverage

The support desk is staffed Monday through Friday from 08:30 to 17:00 in the
Asia/Colombo time zone, excluding Sri Lankan public holidays. Critical tickets
receive an initial response within two business hours during staffed periods.

## Account security

Every staff account must use multi-factor authentication. Access reviews occur
once every quarter, and dormant accounts are disabled after 30 days.
